help:
Commands:
  !quit — quit the game
  !reset — clear the simulation
  !clear — clear the console log
  !save [name] — save the simulation
  !load [name] — load a save from the saves folder
  h, help, !help — show this list
Anything else runs as Lua.
subtitle: sim · elem · ren · evt — scripts run against the live simulation
